subject: Plaza pop-up activation — power dip, broken kiosk, and host no-show
messages:
From: Jess Harper <jess.harper@acmeretail.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Plaza Management <security@plazamanagement.org>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Plaza pop-up — power dip took out our kiosk (urgent)

Mateo,

Quick heads-up from site: at 07:50 local we had a short power dip at the Main St. Plaza feed and one of the temporary kiosks powered off mid-boot. On inspection the touch bezel on Kiosk B has a hairline crack (photo attached). Wi‑Fi briefly dropped but is back now; however the kiosk will not come back online without a manual reboot and possible PSU swap.

We still have the demo van on standby but the plaza manager is pushing for us to remain on the plaza footprint. Our brand host (Liza) is en route but stuck in heavy traffic, ETA unknown. Can Redwood provide:
- quick guidance for a soft reboot sequence (we don't want to corrupt demo content)
- confirmation if you can spin a remote fallback for the live demo (recorded flow + remote Q&A)

Attachment: field-photo-IMG_2219.jpg (phone photo)

Thanks — Jess
Jess Harper
Sr. Events Manager, Acme Retail
jess.harper@acmeretail.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jess Harper <jess.harper@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Plaza pop-up — power dip took out our kiosk (urgent)

Thanks Jess — saw the photo. Quick plan while we triage:
1) Lauren / Logan: can you confirm if we have the spare PSU and the kiosk serials in the van inventory? If so, prep for a swap (priority).
2) Ops vendor (MainStreet Rentals): can you confirm ETA for on-site tech and whether you have a small genset to provide clean 120V at the exact stall circuit? We may need a patch to isolate that circuit.
3) Jess: do the demos have a local fallback (USB with the demo app) we can hand over to the host if the kiosk remains offline? If the host can't make, we want to run a remote-led demo.

I'll spin up a Zoom backup and a lean remote script (short intro + two live prompts) that we can run from laptop. If we need to move into the van temporarily that's fine but keep the crowd in-place — we can do Q&A from the plaza.

Zoom backup: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=roadshow-backup (internal only — will share passcode on call)

-Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Field Marketing, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Plaza pop-up — power dip took out our kiosk (urgent)

Hi all,

Tech update: our field tech (Marco) is on his way, ETA ~20 minutes. We do have a 3kW inverter genset that can provide stable power to the kiosk circuit but it requires a 20A twist-lock adapter; Marco will bring the adapter. We can also swap the PSU on Kiosk B if you approve the onsite labor and parts charge.

Estimate / attachments: rental-invoice-4852.pdf (temporary genset run for 3 hours + labor). We can start the run immediately upon sign-off from RedWood or Acme.

If you need us to temporarily re-rack the kiosk to the van for power isolation while repairs happen, we can do that but it will require a 15-minute window and a brief teardown.

- MainStreet Ops
ops@mainstreetrentals.com

- Logan: get the van prepped with the spare PSU, HDMI fallback laptop, and the mic system. Bring two 20A extension runs and the toolkit.
- Mateo: I'll authorize MainStreet's genset run up to $350 on our card right now; please confirm you want us to proceed.
- Tessa: can you hold the crowd with a 3–4 minute teaser while we do either the swap or move to the van? Use the printed talking points in the kit: intro, 2 feature bullets, CTA for sign-ups.

Jess — if Liza can't make, we'll run remote-hosted Q&A (we can feed audio to the plaza mic). Logan, coordinate with Plaza Security for safe cable runs.

-Lauren

We do have a local USB with the demo (last updated 11/10) and two promotional flyers. If you need to hand the audience off, team on the ground can do it.

-Jess

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Plaza pop-up — power dip took out our kiosk (urgent)

Thanks all. Confirming actions executed at 09:30:
- MainStreet started genset (Marco on-site) — kiosk power isolated and soft‑reboot completed. Kiosk B is back online for a test session.
- Logan moved the backup laptop to the front table and loaded the USB demo as fallback.
- Tessa running 3 minute intro to keep crowd while we validate UX flows.
- Remote backup: Zoom up and passcode distributed to internal ops team. Jess — we'll take Liza's 10:15 remote intro if she can join; otherwise we'll run a recorded intro at 10:05 and open to Q&A at 10:15 with a remote engineer.

Please keep receipts for any third‑party spend. I'll follow up after the event with a short incident report and ask Acme/venue for a credit on their end if the power dip came from plaza-side fault.

-Mateo

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: Post-mortem / follow-ups: Plaza pop-up (11/18)

Wrap-up notes from on-site:
- Incident: 07:50 brief power dip on plaza distribution panel caused kiosk PSU failure (likely a surge). Kiosk B bezel cracked during jostle — not our fault per vendor statement.
- Short-term remediation: MainStreet genset run + PSU swap restored kiosk by ~09:05. We ran a recorded intro at 10:05 and remote Q&A at 10:15 (no-show Liza did remote 2-minute intro at 10:18).
- Customer impact: ~15 minutes of reduced interactivity; approximately 40 people saw the recorded flow, 18 stayed for Q&A.
- Costs: MainStreet rental $295 (attached invoice). Minor promo flyer reprints.

Follow-ups / asks:
1) Lauren — please route the rental invoice to Finance for reimbursement; include MainStreet's statement that the plaza distribution had an upstream glitch.
2) Hannah — let's add a hardening item to the Roadshow SOP: require a spare inline UPS and two extra twist-lock adapters in each van.
3) Logan — inventory the kiosk bezel damage for warranty/claims and capture serials; include photos in the ticket.
4) Jess / Acme — please confirm if you will submit a venue credit request to Plaza Management for the disruption.

Attachments: site-layout-v3.pdf (final layout), rental-invoice-4852.pdf, field-photo-IMG_2219.jpg

Thanks team — handled cleanly, quick de‑escalation. I will file a short incident log in the Roadshow Confluence.

-Mateo Alvarez
